name: Berkeley, California

coverage.summary: The City of Berkeley, and employers with 10 or more employees in Berkeley in building services, healthcare, hotels, manufacturing, retail or warehouse services with 56 or more employees globally; restaurants with 100 or more globally; retail or restaurant franchisees whose network employs 100 or more; and nonprofits in those industries with 100 or more.
coverage.employerThreshold: 10+ in Berkeley and 56+ globally (restaurants, franchisees and nonprofits: 100+)
coverage.employees: Non-exempt employees who work at least 2 hours a week in Berkeley and are entitled to the California minimum wage.

citation.quote: Employers shall provide employees with at least two weeks' notice of their work schedules.

premiums.label: Hours cut or shift cancelled with less than 24 hours' notice

citation.quote: With less than 24 hours notice to the employee, when hours are cancelled or reduced, four hours or the number of cancelled or reduced hours in the employee's scheduled shift, whichever is less.

premiums.label: Hours added or shift moved with less than 24 hours' notice

citation.quote: With less than 24 hours notice to the employee, for additions and all other changes, one hour of predictability pay.

premiums.label: Any change with less than 14 days' but at least 24 hours' notice

citation.quote: With less than 14 days notice, but 24 hours or more notice to the employee: one hour of predictability pay.

An employee who agrees in writing to work hours described in this section shall be compensated at one and one-half times the employee's regular rate of pay for any hours worked less than 11 hours following the end of a previous shift.

exceptions.label: Shift swap or coverage I agreed to with a coworker
exceptions.description: Mutually agreed shift swaps or coverage between employees.

exceptions.label: I asked for this change
exceptions.description: Employee-initiated voluntary changes, such as leaving early or using leave.

exceptions.label: I stayed up to 30 minutes to finish with a customer
exceptions.description: Up to 30 minutes past the end of the shift to finish serving a customer, paid.

exceptions.label: Work couldn't begin or continue
exceptions.description: Threats or a civil authority's recommendation, a utility failure, or acts of nature, a pandemic, war, civil unrest or strikes.

exceptions.label: Manufacturing delay outside the employer's control
exceptions.description: For manufacturers: delays outside the manufacturer's control.

exceptions.label: Healthcare disaster or surge
exceptions.description: For healthcare employers: disasters or unexpected surges.

otherRights.label: Right to decline hours not on your posted schedule
Right to decline hours less than 11 hours after your previous shift

enforcement.agency: City of Berkeley, Labor Standards & Enforcement

sources.title: Berkeley Municipal Code ch. 13.102 (Fair Workweek Employment Standards)
City of Berkeley: Workforce standards and enforcement

notes: Starting or ending within 10 minutes of the scheduled time is exempt (§ 13.102.060(d)(3)(ii)); Shiftowed applies this as an 11-minute threshold.
A cut with less than 24 hours' notice pays the hours cut, up to 4 (the city FAQ: a 15-minute cut owes 0.25 hours).
The rest premium is time and a half on the hours inside the 11-hour window, and stacks with predictability pay. Shiftowed shows the extra half-time.
Employees paid a salary of at least 40 hours a week at twice the minimum wage are not covered.
